blurb: Welcome to Woodford, built as an elegant country retreat for affluent families in colonial Philadelphia it became a former home to both Patriots and British Loyalists in the American Revolutionary War. Today, the National Historic Landmark is owned by the city of Philadelphia and operated by The Naomi Wood Trust, featuring one of the City’s finest collections of 18th-century decorative arts.
